modalities.evidence: The following physiological signals were measured non-invasively

output.population: Fourteen healthy young individuals were recruited for this study conducted in 2018 at the University of Oklahoma
output.summary: Cerebral hemodynamic recordings during an n-back cognitive task in healthy young adults, combining frontal fNIRS oxy- and deoxyhemoglobin signals with transcranial Doppler blood flow velocity in the middle cerebral arteries.
